name: University of Vienna founded
summary: Duke Rudolf IV's foundation charter (12 March 1365) establishes the Studium Generale at Vienna in deliberate competition with Charles IV's Prague. Urban V's confirmation follows in 1384; Vienna becomes the second-largest Central European university by the early 15th century.

_quarry.structural_significance: Habsburg dynastic anchor and major Central European seat of scholastic theology and natural philosophy; later produces the Vienna astronomical school (Peuerbach, Regiomontanus).
